body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within natural weapon range. On a success, deal 1 Piercing damage. If the creature is wounded, ignore 1 Defense.

surges.html: Choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing; this Action deals that damage type.
Ignore 1 Defense from concealment or cover for this Action.

rider.title: PREDATOR ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Hunter Form. While maintained: The first time each turn you attack a creature that has no adjacent ally, ignore 1 Defense.
